en.s: The Battle of Wels (10/12 August 943) was fought between a joint Bavarian–Carantanian army and a Hungarian force near Wels in the Traungau, on the plain of the Welser Heide, nowadays a part of Austria.

zh.s: 韦尔斯战役（943年8月10日或12日）发生在特劳恩高地区的韦尔斯附近、今属奥地利的韦尔瑟海德平原上，交战双方是巴伐利亚—卡兰塔尼亚联军与匈牙利军队。

en.s: The Battle of Lechfeld, also known as the Second Battle of Lechfeld, was a series of military engagements over the course of three days from 10 to 12 August 955 in which the Kingdom of Germany, led by King Otto I the Great, defeated the Hungarian army led by Harka Bulcsú and the chieftains Lél and Súr. With the German victory, further major invasions by the Magyars into Western Europe were ended.

zh.s: 莱希费尔德战役又称第二次莱希费尔德战役，是一系列持续三天的军事交战，于955年8月10日至12日发生。奥托一世大帝率领的德意志王国军队击败了由布尔楚可汗以及首领莱尔和舒尔率领的匈牙利军队。德军获胜后，马扎尔人不再大举入侵西欧。

en.s: The Battle of Ascalon took place on 12 August 1099 shortly after the capture of Jerusalem. Often considered the last action of the First Crusade, the Crusader army led by Godfrey of Bouillon defeated and drove off a Fatimid army of Egypt. The Crusaders completed their primary objective of capturing Jerusalem on 15 July 1099. In early August, they learned of the approach of a 20,000-strong Fatimid army under vizier al-Afdal Shahanshah.

zh.s: 阿斯卡隆战役发生于1099年8月12日，即耶路撒冷被攻占后不久。这场战斗常被视为第一次十字军东征的最后一战。布永的戈弗雷率领十字军击败并驱退了埃及法蒂玛王朝的军队。十字军已于1099年7月15日完成攻占耶路撒冷的主要目标。8月初，他们得知宰相阿夫达尔·沙汉沙率领一支2万人的法蒂玛军队正向此地进发。

en.s: The Battle of Didgori (Georgian: დიდგორის ბრძოლა, romanized: didgoris brdzola) was fought between the armies of the Kingdom of Georgia and the Seljuk Empire at the narrow place of Didgori, 40 km west of Tbilisi, on August 12, 1121. The large Muslim army, under the command of Ilghazi, was unable to maneuver and suffered a devastating defeat due to King David IV's effective military tactics.

zh.s: 迪德戈里战役于1121年8月12日在迪德戈里狭窄地带爆发，交战双方是格鲁吉亚王国和塞尔柱帝国的军队。迪德戈里位于第比利斯以西40公里处。伊尔加齐率领的穆斯林大军无法展开阵形，遭到格鲁吉亚国王大卫四世运用有效战术重创。

en.s: The Slavic raid on Kungahälla or the Battle of Kungahälla targeted the Norwegian port city of Kungahälla, conducted by the Pomeranians of the Duchy of Pomerania under Ratibor I against the Kingdom of Norway, on 10–12 August 1135.

zh.s: 波美拉尼亚公国的拉蒂博尔一世率领波美拉尼亚人，于1135年8月10日至12日袭击挪威港口城市昆加海拉，这场冲突也称昆加海拉战役。

en.s: The Battle of Harim (Harenc) was fought on 12 August 1164 near Artah between the forces of Nur ad-Din Zangi and a combined army from the County of Tripoli, the Principality of Antioch, the Byzantine Empire and Armenia. Nur ad-Din won a crushing victory, capturing most of the leaders of the opposing army.

zh.s: 哈里姆（哈伦克）战役于1164年8月12日在阿尔塔赫附近爆发，交战双方是努尔丁·赞吉的军队与的黎波里伯国、安条克公国、拜占庭帝国和亚美尼亚组成的联军。努尔丁大获全胜，俘获了对方大多数将领。

en.s: The Pillage of Sigtuna was the raid of the Swedish town of Sigtuna by pagans from the Eastern Baltic in 1187, leading to its destruction. The pillage is most commonly attributed to Estonians, Curonians, Karelians, or Novgorodians. The pillage of Sigtuna became part of Estonian national discourse. The destruction of Sigtuna also received prominence in Sweden, due to belief of giving a rise to Stockholm as the new Swedish capital.

zh.s: 1187年，来自波罗的海东部的异教徒袭击瑞典城镇锡格图纳并将其毁坏。这次劫掠通常被归于爱沙尼亚人、库尔人、卡累利阿人或诺夫哥罗德人。锡格图纳遭劫掠一事后来成为爱沙尼亚民族叙事的一部分；在瑞典，这座城市被毁也受到关注，因为有人认为这促成了斯德哥尔摩成为新的瑞典首都。

en.s: The Treaty of Nöteborg, also known as the Treaty of Oreshek or the Treaty of Pähkinäsaari, was the peace treaty signed at Oreshek Fortress (Swedish: Nöteborg; Finnish: Pähkinälinna) on 12 August 1323. It was the first agreement between Sweden and the Novgorod Republic regulating their border on the Karelian Isthmus and parts of modern-day Finland. Three years later, Novgorod signed the Treaty of Novgorod with the Norwegians.

zh.s: 诺特堡条约又称奥列舍克条约或帕赫基纳萨里条约，于1323年8月12日在奥列舍克要塞签署。该要塞的瑞典语名称为Nöteborg，芬兰语名称为Pähkinälinna。这是瑞典和诺夫哥罗德共和国之间首份划定卡累利阿地峡及今芬兰部分地区边界的协议。三年后，诺夫哥罗德又与挪威人签订《诺夫哥罗德条约》。

en.s: The siege of Zadar (12 August 1345 – 21 December 1346) was a successful attempt of the Republic of Venice to capture Zadar (or Zara), a Croatian coastal city in northern Dalmatia. It was a combined land and sea offensive by the Venetians, consisting of many separate battles and operations against the citizens of Zadar, who refused to accept Venetian suzerainty and demanded autonomy.

zh.s: 扎达尔围城战是威尼斯共和国为攻占克罗地亚北达尔马提亚沿海城市扎达尔（又称扎拉）而发动的一次成功军事行动，时间为1345年8月12日至1346年12月21日。威尼斯军队从陆海两路进攻，发起多场战斗和行动；扎达尔居民拒绝接受威尼斯的宗主权，并要求自治。

en.s: The Battle of the Vorskla River was fought on August 12, 1399, between the Tatars of the Golden Horde, under Edigu and Temür Qutlugh, and the armies of Tokhtamysh and a large Crusader force led by Grand Duke Vytautas the Great of Lithuania. The battle ended in a decisive Tatar victory for the Golden Horde.

zh.s: 沃尔斯克拉河战役于1399年8月12日爆发，交战双方是埃迪古和帖木儿·忽秃鲁率领的金帐汗国鞑靼军，以及脱脱迷失的军队和立陶宛大公维陶塔斯率领的大批十字军。金帐汗国鞑靼军取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The siege of Cherbourg took place in 1450 during the Hundred Years' War when French forces laid siege to Cherbourg in the English-controlled Duchy of Normandy following their decisive victory at the Battle of Formigny. With the fall of Cherbourg, English control of Normandy was removed.

zh.s: 百年战争期间，法军在1450年围攻由英格兰控制的诺曼底公国瑟堡，此前法军已在福尔米尼战役取得决定性胜利。瑟堡陷落后，英格兰失去了对诺曼底的控制。

en.s: The Normandy campaign of 1449–1450 took place during the Hundred Years War when the Kingdom of France undertook a military campaign to retake Normandy from the English. The war began due to the English breaking the Treaty of Tours with the surprise capture of Fougères in March, then France and Brittany retaliated and signed an alliance, declaring war on England on July 31, 1449.

zh.s: 百年战争期间，法兰西王国于1449—1450年发动军事行动，试图从英格兰手中收复诺曼底。英格兰在3月突然攻占富热尔，违反《图尔条约》，引发战争；法国和布列塔尼随后反击并结盟，于1449年7月31日向英格兰宣战。

en.t: First engagement of the Battle of Zonchio between Venetian and Ottoman fleets
en.s: The naval Battle of Zonchio (Turkish: Sapienza Deniz Muharebesi, also known as the Battle of Sapienza or the First Battle of Lepanto) took place on four separate days: 12, 20, 22, and 25 August 1499. It was a part of the Ottoman–Venetian War of 1499–1503. During its course, the Venetians attempted to intercept an Ottoman fleet en route to conquer Lepanto, but were hampered by miscoordination and repeatedly failed to engage the Ottomans.

zh.t: 威尼斯舰队与奥斯曼舰队在宗基奥海战中首次交锋
zh.s: 宗基奥海战（土耳其语：Sapienza Deniz Muharebesi，也称萨皮恩扎海战或第一次勒班陀海战）分四天进行：1499年8月12日、20日、22日和25日。它是1499—1503年奥斯曼—威尼斯战争的一部分。威尼斯舰队试图拦截一支正准备征服勒班陀的奥斯曼舰队，但因协调不当而受阻，屡次未能与奥斯曼军交战。

en.s: The Battle of Murjakheti was fought between the armies of the Kingdom of Imereti and the Samtskhe-Saatabago at the place of Murjakheti near Akhalkalaki, on 12 August 1535.

zh.s: 穆尔贾赫季战役于1535年8月12日在穆尔贾赫季附近爆发，交战双方是伊梅列季王国和萨姆茨赫-萨塔巴戈的军队。战场靠近阿哈尔卡拉基。

en.s: The Battle of Renty was fought on 12 August 1554, between France and the Holy Roman Empire at Renty, a northern French secondary theatre of the Italian Wars. The French were led by Francis, Duke of Guise, while the Imperial forces were led by Emperor Charles V of Habsburg. On 8 August, the French appeared at Renty. The Spanish cavalry charged the French infantry forcing a retreat, while their infantry were in the Bois Guillaume. The French infantry were rallied by Gaspar de Saulx-Tavannes who charged, while the Spanish infantry were pushed out of the woods by Gaspard de Coligny, and routed by Francis, Duke of Guise.

zh.s: 朗蒂战役于1554年8月12日爆发，是意大利战争期间法国北部次要战场上的一场战斗，交战双方为法国和神圣罗马帝国。法军由吉斯公爵弗朗索瓦率领，帝国军由哈布斯堡王朝皇帝查理五世率领。8月8日，法军出现在朗蒂。西班牙骑兵冲击法军步兵，迫使其撤退；西班牙步兵则驻扎在纪尧姆树林。加斯帕尔·德·索指挥法军步兵重整并发起冲锋；加斯帕尔·德·科利尼将西班牙步兵赶出树林，随后吉斯公爵弗朗索瓦将其击溃。

en.s: The siege of Åbo (1563) was a siege of Åbo (Turku) by the royal army under King Eric XIV of Sweden against his brother Duke John of Finland (later King John III) in 1563.

zh.s: 1563年，瑞典国王埃里克十四世率领王室军队围攻奥博（今芬兰图尔库），对手是他的弟弟、芬兰公爵约翰（后来的约翰三世）。

en.s: The Battle of Shklov (also spelt Shklow, Szkłów, or Shkloŭ) took place on August 12, 1654, and was one of the first battles of the Russo-Polish War (1654–67); it ended with a indecisive, however, by other sources. A small Polish–Lithuanian force of about 6,000–7,000 under Great Lithuanian Hetman Janusz Radziwiłł surprised a numerically superior Russian force (of 40,000; some estimates speak of 70,000, but they are likely too high) under knyaz Yakov Cherkassky near Shklow (Polish: Szkłów).

zh.s: 什克洛夫战役也拼作Shklow、Szkłów或Shkloŭ，于1654年8月12日发生，是俄波战争（1654—1667年）初期的战役之一。战果据称未能定论，但其他资料有不同说法。扬努什·拉齐维乌的立陶宛大盖特曼率领约6,000至7,000名波兰—立陶宛士兵，在什克洛夫附近出其不意地袭击了兵力占优的俄军。俄军由雅科夫·切尔卡斯基公爵率领，兵力为40,000人（有些估计称70,000人，但这一数字可能过高）。什克洛夫的波兰语名为Szkłów。

en.s: The Second Battle of Mohács, also known as the Battle of Harsány Mountain, was fought on 12 August 1687 between the forces of Ottoman Sultan Mehmed IV, commanded by the Grand Vizier Sarı Süleyman Pasha, and the forces of Leopold I, Holy Roman Emperor, commanded by Charles of Lorraine. The result was a decisive victory for the Austrians.

zh.s: 第二次莫哈奇战役又称哈尔沙尼山战役，于1687年8月12日爆发。奥斯曼帝国苏丹穆罕默德四世的军队由大维齐尔萨勒·苏莱曼帕夏指挥；神圣罗马帝国皇帝利奥波德一世的军队由洛林的查理指挥。奥军取得决定性胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Kunersdorf, fought in the Seven Years' War, was Frederick the Great's most devastating defeat. On August 12, 1759, near Kunersdorf (Kunowice), east of Frankfurt (Oder), 50,900 Prussians were defeated by a combined allied army 65,000 strong consisting of 41,000 Russians and 24,000 Austrians under Pyotr Saltykov and Ernst Gideon von Laudon. Only 3,000 soldiers from the original 50,900 comprising the Prussian army returned to Berlin after the battle, though many more had only scattered and were ultimately able to join the army afterward.

zh.s: 昆讷斯多夫战役发生于七年战争期间，是腓特烈大帝遭遇的最惨重败仗。1759年8月12日，在奥得河畔法兰克福以东的昆讷斯多夫（今库诺维采）附近，5.09万名普鲁士士兵被一支由彼得·萨尔特科夫和恩斯特·吉迪恩·冯·劳东率领的联军击败。联军共6.5万人，其中俄军4.1万人、奥军2.4万人。普鲁士军原有5.09万人，战后只有3000人返回柏林；不过还有许多士兵只是走散，后来重新归队。

en.s: The action of 12 August 1782 was a minor single-ship action that opposed the French 32-gun frigate Bellone to the British 28-gun HMS Coventry in the run-up to the Battle of Trincomalee. Although both ships were frigates, Bellone belonged to the Iphigénie class and was a comparatively large frigate for her time, carrying a battery of 18-pounder long guns, while Coventry was a sixth-rate armed only with 9-pounder long guns.

zh.s: 1782年8月12日的海战是特林科马里海战前的一场小规模单舰交战，法军32炮护卫舰“贝隆”号与英军28炮“考文垂”号交战。两舰虽同为护卫舰，但“贝隆”号属于伊菲热尼级，在当时算较大型护卫舰，配备18磅长炮；“考文垂”号则是六等舰，只装备9磅长炮。

en.t: 1796–97 United States House of Representatives elections
en.s: The 1796–97 United States House of Representatives elections took place in the various states between August 12, 1796 (in North Carolina), and October 15, 1797 (in Tennessee). Each state set its own date for its elections to the House of Representatives. The size of the House increased to 106 seats after Tennessee became the 16th U.S. state to join the union.

zh.s: 1796—1797年美国众议院选举在各州分期举行，时间从1796年8月12日（北卡罗来纳州）到1797年10月15日（田纳西州）。各州自行确定众议院选举日期。田纳西州成为美国第16个州后，众议院席位增至106席。

en.s: The Gunboat War (1807–1814) was a naval conflict between Denmark–Norway and Great Britain supported by Sweden during the Napoleonic Wars. The war's name is derived from the Danish tactic of employing small gunboats against the materially superior Royal Navy. In Scandinavia it is seen as the later stage of the English Wars, whose commencement is accounted as the First Battle of Copenhagen in 1801.

zh.s: 炮艇战争（1807—1814年）是拿破仑战争期间丹麦—挪威与英国之间的海战，瑞典支持英国。战争名称源自丹麦战术：以小型炮艇对抗装备和实力更强的英国皇家海军。在斯堪的纳维亚，这场战争被视为后期英格兰战争的一部分；后者通常以1801年第一次哥本哈根战役为开端。

en.s: The Battle of Puerto de Baños (12 August 1809) saw a Portuguese-Spanish column led by Robert Thomas Wilson attempt to defend a mountain pass against Marshal Michel Ney's VI Corps. After a nine-hour combat, Wilson's force broke up and scattered into the mountains. Baños de Montemayor is located about 45 kilometres (28 mi) northeast of Plasencia, Spain. The clash occurred during the Peninsular War, part of a larger struggle known as the Napoleonic Wars. In the summer of 1809, the British army of Arthur Wellesley, 1st Duke of Wellington marched into western Spain to join Gregorio García de la Cuesta's Spanish army.

zh.s: 巴尼奥斯山口战役发生于1809年8月12日。罗伯特·托马斯·威尔逊率领一支葡萄牙—西班牙联军，试图抵挡米歇尔·内伊元帅第六军团。经过9小时交战，威尔逊的部队溃散，逃入山区。巴尼奥斯-德蒙特马约尔位于西班牙普拉森西亚东北约45公里（28英里）处。这场战斗发生在半岛战争期间；半岛战争是更大范围的拿破仑战争的一部分。1809年夏，阿瑟·韦尔斯利率领的英军进入西班牙西部，与格雷戈里奥·加西亚·德·拉·奎斯塔的西班牙军会合。

en.s: Tecumseh's War was a conflict between the United States and Tecumseh's confederacy, led by the Shawnee leader Tecumseh in the Indiana Territory. Although the war is often considered to have climaxed with William Henry Harrison's victory at the Battle of Tippecanoe in 1811, Tecumseh's War essentially continued into the War of 1812 and is frequently considered a part of that larger struggle.

zh.s: 蒂库姆塞战争是美国与蒂库姆塞联盟之间的冲突，联盟由印第安纳领地的肖尼族领袖蒂库姆塞领导。虽然通常认为战争在1811年威廉·亨利·哈里森于蒂珀卡努战役获胜时达到高潮，但蒂库姆塞战争实际上延续到1812年战争期间，也经常被视为那场更大规模战争的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Gorodechno took place between an army of the Austrian and Saxon allies of Napoleonic France under the overall command of the Prince of Schwarzenberg and Russian troops under Alexander Tormasov at Gorodechno, a town in Kobrinsky Uyezd, Grodno Governorate (now Pruzhany District, Brest Region in Belarus). The battle was ultimately won by France's allies when Tormasov was forced to retire.

zh.s: 戈罗杰奇诺战役中，施瓦岑贝格亲王统率拿破仑法国的奥地利、萨克森盟军，与亚历山大·托尔马索夫率领的俄军交战。战斗发生在戈罗杰奇诺一带，当地当时属格罗德诺省科布林县（今白俄罗斯布列斯特州普鲁扎内区）。法方盟军最终获胜，托尔马索夫被迫撤退。

en.s: The Ten Days' Campaign (Dutch: Tiendaagse veldtocht, French: campagne des Dix-Jours) was a failed military expedition by the United Kingdom of the Netherlands against the secessionist Kingdom of Belgium between 2 and 12 August 1831. The campaign was an attempt by the Dutch King William I to halt the course of the Belgian Revolution which had broken out in August 1830.

zh.s: 十日战役（荷兰语：Tiendaagse veldtocht，法语：campagne des Dix-Jours）是尼德兰联合王国针对分离主义的比利时王国发动的一次失败军事远征，发生于1831年8月2日至12日。荷兰国王威廉一世试图借此阻止1830年8月爆发的比利时革命。

en.s: The Battle of Plum Creek was a clash between allied Tonkawa, militia, and Rangers of the Republic of Texas and a huge Comanche war party under Chief Buffalo Hump, which took place near Lockhart, Texas, on August 12, 1840, following the Great Raid of 1840 as the Comanche war party returned to west Texas.

zh.s: 1840年8月12日，德克萨斯共和国的通卡瓦人盟军、民兵和游骑兵，与布法罗·汉普酋长率领的大批科曼奇人，在得克萨斯州洛克哈特附近交战。科曼奇人是在1840年大劫掠后返回得克萨斯州西部途中遭遇对方的。

en.t: Isaac Singer is granted a patent for his sewing machine
en.s: Isaac Merritt Singer (October 27, 1811 – July 23, 1875) was an American inventor, actor, and businessman. He made important improvements in the design of the sewing machine and was the founder of what became one of the first American multi-national businesses, the Singer Sewing Machine Company.

zh.t: 艾萨克·辛格获缝纫机专利
zh.s: 艾萨克·梅里特·辛格（1811年10月27日—1875年7月23日）是美国发明家、演员和商人。他大幅改进了缝纫机设计，并创办了辛格缝纫机公司；该公司后来成为美国最早的一批跨国企业之一。

en.s: The Battle of Paso de Cuevas was fought on August 12, 1865 during the Paraguayan invasion of the Argentine province of Corrientes. Following losses after the Battle of Riachuelo, and running the gauntlet set up by Bruguez at Bella Vista in the Battle of Paso de Mercedes the day before, the allied fleet advanced down the River Parana, not wanting to be cut off from its supply base. However, the pass at Cuevas was once again manned by 3000 of Bruguez's men with 34 guns. Barroso suffered 24 dead and 42 wounded.

zh.s: 库埃瓦斯隘口战役于1865年8月12日爆发，发生在巴拉圭入侵阿根廷科连特斯省期间。盟军舰队在里亚丘埃洛战役失利后，又于前一天在梅塞德斯隘口战役中冲过布鲁格斯设下的贝亚维斯塔火力封锁，随后沿巴拉那河向下游航行，以免与补给基地失去联系。但库埃瓦斯隘口再次由布鲁格斯的3000名士兵和34门火炮把守。巴罗索一方有24人阵亡、42人受伤。

en.s: The Third Italian War of Independence (Italian: Terza guerra d'indipendenza italiana) was a war between the Kingdom of Italy and the Austrian Empire fought between June and August 1866. The conflict paralleled the Austro-Prussian War and resulted in Austria giving the region of Venetia (present-day Veneto, Friuli and the city of Mantua, the last remnant of the Quadrilatero) to the Second French Empire (acting as intermediary in negotiations), which formally gave it to Italy.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 意大利第三次独立战争
zh.s: 意大利第三次独立战争发生于1866年6月至8月，交战双方为意大利王国和奥地利帝国。战争与普奥战争同时进行。战后，奥地利将威尼托地区（今威尼托、弗留利以及曼图亚市；曼图亚是四边形防线最后保留的据点）交给第二法兰西帝国，后者作为谈判中间方，再将该地区正式交给意大利。

en.s: The Battle of Piribebuy was fought on August 12, 1869 in the Paraguayan town of Piribebuy, which was then serving as a temporary capital of the Paraguayan government. The Paraguayan defenders, who were poorly armed and included children, fought the attacks of the Allied forces, led by French-born Brazilian general Prince Gaston, son-in-law of Emperor Pedro II of Brazil. The town refused two peace envoys, calling for surrender, sent by the Conde d'Eu. At 0400, the Brazilian batteries surrounding the town started a bombardment which lasted until 0800, when the infantry charged. Gen. Jao Manuel Mena Barreto was mortally wounded leading a cavalry charge.

zh.s: 皮里贝布伊战役于1869年8月12日在巴拉圭城镇皮里贝布伊爆发。当时该镇是巴拉圭政府的临时首都。巴拉圭守军装备简陋，其中包括儿童，但仍抵抗由巴西皇帝佩德罗二世女婿、法国出生的加斯东亲王率领的盟军进攻。守军拒绝了欧伯爵派来的两名劝降使者。凌晨4时，包围该镇的巴西炮兵开始炮击；炮击持续到上午8时，随后步兵发起冲锋。骑兵冲锋时，若昂·曼努埃尔·梅纳·巴雷托将军受了致命伤。

en.s: Deimos () is the smaller and outer of the two natural satellites of Mars, the other being Phobos. Deimos has a mean radius of 6.2 km (3.9 mi) and takes 30.3 hours to orbit Mars. Deimos is 23,457.50 km (14,575.81 mi) from Mars, much farther than Mars's other moon, Phobos. It is named after Deimos, the Ancient Greek god and personification of dread and terror.

zh.s: 火卫二（Deimos）是火星两颗天然卫星中较小、较外侧的一颗，另一颗是火卫一。火卫二平均半径为6.2公里（3.9英里），绕火星运行一周需30.3小时。它距火星23,457.50公里（14,575.81英里），比火星的另一颗卫星火卫一远得多。它以古希腊神祇兼恐惧与惊骇的化身德伊莫斯命名。

en.s: The Battle of Carrizo Canyon was one of several battles between Apache warriors and United States Cavalry troops in New Mexico Territory. On August 12, 1881 a squad on nineteen 10th Cavalry Buffalo Soldiers were attacked by native warriors in Carrizo Canyon.

zh.s: 卡里索峡谷战役是新墨西哥领地阿帕奇战士与美国骑兵之间多场战斗之一。1881年8月12日，一支由19名第10骑兵团士兵组成的小队在卡里索峡谷遭到当地战士袭击。

en.s: The Battle of Aba, which took place on 12 August 1881, was the opening battle of the Mahdist War. The incident saw Mahdist rebels, led by Muhammad Ahmad, who had proclaimed himself the Mahdi, rout Egyptian troops who had landed on Aba Island.

zh.s: 阿巴岛战役于1881年8月12日爆发，是马赫迪战争的首场战斗。自称马赫迪的穆罕默德·艾哈迈德率领马赫迪派叛军，击溃了在阿巴岛登陆的埃及军队。

en.s: The Second Eastern Campaign was a military campaign that took place between August 1 to 12, 1898, in the Oriente Province of Cuba during the Cuban War of Independence. It was the shortest military campaign of the entire war and it was the one that marked the end of Spanish reign in Cuba and the Spanish Empire in Latin America.

zh.s: 第二次东部战役是古巴独立战争期间在古巴奥连特省进行的一场军事行动，时间为1898年8月1日至12日。这是整场战争中持续时间最短的一次军事行动，并标志着西班牙对古巴的统治以及西班牙帝国在拉丁美洲的统治走向结束。

en.s: The Battle of Mečkin Kamen also known as 'Battle of Mechkin Kamen' (Bulgarian: Битка при Мечкин Камен, Macedonian: Битка кај Мечкин Камен) occurred on the hill now known as Mečkin Kamen ("Bear's Stone"), a few kilometres south from the town of Kruševo on 12 August 1903. It was part of the Ilinden-Preobrazhenie Uprising, led by the Internal Macedonian-Adrianople Revolutionary Organisation (IMARO or VMARO) against the Ottoman Empire.

zh.s: 梅奇金卡门战役又称“熊石战役”，于1903年8月12日在一座现称梅奇金卡门（“熊石”）的山丘上爆发，地点距克鲁舍沃镇以南数公里。这场战斗属于伊林登—普列奥布拉任尼起义，是马其顿内部革命组织（IMARO，又称VMARO）领导的反抗奥斯曼帝国行动之一。

en.s: The Battle of Halen or Haelen, was a cavalry battle at the beginning of World War I. The battle is also known as the Battle of the Silver Helmets (Dutch: Slag der Zilveren Helmen French: Bataille des casques d'argent), an analogy with the Battle of the Golden Spurs of 1302, because of the many cavalry helmets left behind on the battlefield by the German Cuirassiers. Halen is a small market town which was on the principal axis of advance of the Imperial German army, where there was a good crossing point over the Gete River.

zh.s: 哈伦战役（也称海伦战役）是第一次世界大战初期的一场骑兵战。因德军胸甲骑兵在战场上留下许多头盔，这场战役也被称为“银盔战役”（荷兰语：Slag der Zilveren Helmen；法语：Bataille des casques d’argent）；这个称呼让人联想到1302年的金马刺战役。哈伦是一座小型集镇，位于德意志帝国军队的主要推进路线上，也是赫特河上一处适宜渡河的地点。

en.s: The Battle of Amiens, also known as the Third Battle of Picardy, was the opening phase of the Allied offensive which began on 8 August 1918, later known as the Hundred Days Offensive, which ultimately led to the end of World War I.

zh.s: 亚眠战役又称第三次皮卡第战役，是协约国攻势的开端阶段。该攻势于1918年8月8日开始，后来被称为百日攻势，并最终导致第一次世界大战结束。

en.s: The Kurtez ambush occurred on August 12, 1943, near the village of Kurtez in the Kolonjë District of Korçë County in southeastern Albania. It was carried out by Balli Kombëtar during the Albanian Resistance of World War II. Two hundred local Balli Kombëtar militants, commanded by Qemal Burimi and David Smiley, ambushed a German convoy and a troop carrier, inflicting heavy losses on the German troops.

zh.s: 库尔特兹伏击战于1943年8月12日在阿尔巴尼亚东南部科尔察州科隆涅区库尔特兹村附近发生。伏击由民族阵线组织在第二次世界大战期间的阿尔巴尼亚抵抗运动中实施。200名当地民族阵线武装人员在凯马尔·布鲁米和戴维·斯迈利指挥下，伏击了一支德国车队和一辆运兵车，给德军造成重大损失。

en.s: The Sant'Anna di Stazzema massacre was a Nazi German war crime committed in the hill village of Sant'Anna di Stazzema in Tuscany, Italy, in the course of an operation against the Italian resistance movement during the Italian Campaign of World War II. On 12 August 1944, about 560 (130 children) local villagers and refugees were murdered and their bodies burnt in a scorched earth policy action by the German occupation forces of the Waffen-SS. These crimes have been defined as voluntary and organized acts of terrorism by the Military Tribunal of La Spezia and the highest Italian court of appeal.

zh.t: 圣安娜迪斯塔泽马大屠杀
zh.s: 圣安娜迪斯塔泽马大屠杀是纳粹德国在第二次世界大战意大利战役期间针对意大利抵抗运动的一次行动中犯下的战争罪行，地点是意大利托斯卡纳的山村圣安娜迪斯塔泽马。1944年8月12日，德国占领军武装党卫军实施焦土行动，屠杀约560名当地村民和难民，其中包括130名儿童，并焚烧尸体。拉斯佩齐亚军事法庭和意大利最高上诉法院认定，这些罪行是有意组织实施的恐怖行为。

en.s: The Wola massacre (Polish: Rzeź Woli, lit. 'Wola slaughter') was the systematic killing of between 40,000 and 50,000 Poles in the Wola neighbourhood of the Polish capital city, Warsaw, by the German Waffen-SS, Ordnungpolizei, the Azerbaijani Legion, Sicherheitdienst and the SS-Sonderregiment Dirlewanger, which took place from 5 to 12 August 1944. The massacre was ordered by Heinrich Himmler, who directed to kill "anything that moves" to stop the Warsaw Uprising soon after it began.

zh.s: 沃拉大屠杀又称“沃拉屠杀”，是德国武装党卫军、秩序警察、阿塞拜疆军团、安全警察局以及迪尔旺格党卫军特别团在波兰首都华沙的沃拉区系统杀害4万至5万名波兰人的事件，发生于1944年8月5日至12日。海因里希·希姆莱下令在华沙起义爆发后不久杀死“一切会动的东西”，以镇压起义。

en.s: The Babrra massacre occurred on 12 August 1948 in the Charsadda District of the North-West Frontier Province (now Khyber Pukhtunkhwa) of Pakistan, when unarmed workers of the Khudai Khidmatgar movement were fired upon by the provincial government on the orders of the then Chief Minister Khan Abdul Qayyum Khan. The protest was against the promulgation of Public Safety Ordinance by the provincial governor and the resulting arrests of Khudai Khidmatgar leaders and confiscations of properties.

zh.s: 巴布拉大屠杀发生于1948年8月12日，地点在巴基斯坦西北边境省查尔萨达县（今开伯尔-普赫图赫瓦省）。当时，省政府奉时任首席部长汗·阿卜杜勒·卡尤姆·汗之命，向胡达伊·希德马特加尔运动的手无寸铁成员开枪。抗议者反对省长颁布《公共安全条例》，以及由此引发的胡达伊·希德马特加尔领导人被捕和财产被没收。

en.s: The Bloody Gulch massacre was a war crime that took place in the Korean War on August 12, 1950 in "Bloody Gulch", west of Masan, South Korea. After a very successful attack on two undefended US Artillery Battalions that killed or wounded hundreds of US troops, members of the North Korean People's Army (KPA) 13th Regiment executed seventy-five captured US Army prisoners of war during one of the smaller engagements of the Battle of Pusan Perimeter. The troops were from the 555th Field Artillery Battalion (24th Infantry Division) and the 90th Field Artillery Battalion (25th Infantry Division).

zh.s: 血腥峡谷大屠杀是朝鲜战争期间发生的战争罪行，时间为1950年8月12日，地点在韩国马山以西的“血腥峡谷”。朝鲜人民军第13团在一次较小规模的釜山环形防御战交战中，处决了75名被俘的美国陆军战俘。此前，朝鲜军队曾成功袭击两个没有防备的美军炮兵营，造成数百名美军士兵死伤。这些战俘来自第555野战炮兵营（第24步兵师）和第90野战炮兵营（第25步兵师）。

en.s: The Night of the Murdered Poets occurred on 12 August 1952, and it involved the execution of 13 Soviet Jews in the Lubyanka Prison in Moscow. Arrests were made in September 1948 and June 1949, with all defendants having been convicted of espionage and treason, as well as many other crimes. Following their arrests and detention, they were tortured, beaten, and isolated for three years before being formally charged.
en.n: The Night of the Murdered Poets occurred on 12 August 1952, and it involved the execution of 13 Soviet Jews in the Lubyanka Prison in Moscow.

zh.s: 遇害诗人之夜发生于1952年8月12日，莫斯科卢比扬卡监狱处决了13名苏联犹太人。他们于1948年9月和1949年6月被捕，随后被拘押、折磨、殴打并单独关押三年，之后才被正式起诉。所有被告均被判犯有间谍罪、叛国罪及多项其他罪行。
zh.n: 遇害诗人之夜发生于1952年8月12日，莫斯科卢比扬卡监狱处决了13名苏联犹太人。

en.s: The Ionian Islands (Modern Greek: Ιόνια νησιά, Ionia nisia; Ancient Greek, Katharevousa: Ἰόνιαι Νῆσοι, Ioniai Nēsoi) are a group of islands in the Ionian Sea, west of mainland Greece. They are traditionally called the Heptanese ("Seven Islands"; Ἑπτάνησα, Heptanēsa or Ἑπτάνησος, Heptanēsos; Italian: Eptaneso), but the group includes many smaller islands in addition to the seven principal ones.
en.n: The 1953 Ionian islands earthquake occurred with a surface wave magnitude of 7.2 and a maximum Mercalli intensity of X (Extreme) on August 12, 1953.

zh.s: 爱奥尼亚群岛（现代希腊语：Ιόνια νησιά，Ionia nisia；古希腊语和卡塔列乌萨希腊语：Ἰόνιαι Νῆσοι，Ioniai Nēsoi）是爱奥尼亚海上的一组岛屿，位于希腊大陆以西。它们传统上称为赫普塔尼斯群岛（意为“七岛”；希腊语：Ἑπτάνησα，Heptanēsa或Ἑπτάνησος，Heptanēsos；意大利语：Eptaneso），但除七座主要岛屿外，这个群岛还包括许多较小岛屿。
zh.n: 1953年爱奥尼亚群岛地震发生于1953年8月12日，面波震级为7.2，最高麦加利烈度为X级（极震）。

en.s: The Battle of Bouzegza took place during the Algerian War in the Berber-speaking region of the Adrar Azegzaw massif (Djebel Bouzegza, which means "Bouzegza Mountain"), at the far eastern end of the Mitidja Plain. On August 4, 8, and 12, 1957, Ali Khodja of the National Liberation Army (ALN), reinforced with local units, faced French Army units commanded by several generals, including Jacques Massu.

zh.s: 布泽格扎战役发生在阿尔及利亚战争期间，战场位于柏柏尔语地区阿德拉尔·阿泽格扎山块（布泽格扎山，意为“布泽格扎山”），即米提贾平原最东端。1957年8月4日、8日和12日，民族解放军（ALN）的阿里·霍贾率当地部队增援，与包括雅克·马絮在内的数名将军指挥的法国军队交战。

en.s: Indirect presidential elections were held in South Korea on 12 August 1960, which saw the election of Yun Posun as President of the Republic of Korea, a ceremonial political position in the Second Republic. Held after the April Revolution which had forced the resignation of Syngman Rhee, it was the only presidential election to be held during the short era of the Second Republic, as the Republic folded after Park Chung Hee's May Coup the next year.

zh.s: 韩国于1960年8月12日举行总统间接选举，选出尹潽善担任大韩民国总统。这一职位在第二共和国时期主要是礼仪性职务。此次选举在四一九革命迫使李承晚辞职后举行，也是短暂的第二共和国时期唯一一次总统选举。次年朴正熙发动五月政变，第二共和国随之终结。

en.t: Echo 1A, NASA's first successful communications satellite, is launched
en.s: Project Echo was a passive communications satellite experiment designed by the American National Aeronautics and Space Agency (NASA) as the first test of man-made satellite communication in history. Each of the two spacecraft, launched in 1960 and 1964, were metalized balloon satellites acting as passive reflectors of microwave signals. Communication signals were transmitted from one location on Earth and bounced off the surface of the satellite to another Earth location.

zh.t: 美国国家航空航天局首次成功的通信卫星回声1A号发射升空
zh.s: 回声计划是美国国家航空航天局（NASA）设计的一项无源通信卫星实验，也是历史上首次对人造卫星通信进行测试。两艘航天器分别于1960年和1964年发射，都是金属化气球卫星，用作微波信号的无源反射器。通信信号从地球一处发射，经卫星表面反射后传到地球另一处。

en.s: The 1961 FA Charity Shield was the 39th FA Charity Shield. The match was contested on 12 August 1961 between double winners Tottenham Hotspur and a Football Association (F.A.) representative eleven. Tottenham won the match 3–2. In the 1960–61 season, Tottenham had become the first club since Aston Villa in 1897 to complete the Double, that is, to win the FA Cup and Division One in the same season.

en.s: The modern Olympic Games (Olympics; French: Jeux olympiques) are a series of international multi-sport events. Considered among the biggest sporting events in the world, the Olympics are organised into distinct Summer and Winter Games, each featuring different sports. The Olympic Games, open to both amateur and professional athletes, involve thousands of athletes and more than 200 teams, each team representing a sovereign state or territory.
en.n: South Africa is banned from the Olympic Games due to the country's racist policies.

zh.s: 现代奥林匹克运动会（简称奥运会；法语：Jeux olympiques）是一系列国际综合体育赛事，被视为世界上规模最大的体育赛事之一。奥运会分为夏季和冬季赛事，项目各不相同。无论业余或职业运动员均可参加，每届赛事都有数千名运动员和200多个代表团，每个代表团代表一个主权国家或地区。

en.s: The Tel al-Zaatar massacre was the killing of approximately 1,500 Palestinians and Lebanese Muslims in the Tel al-Zaatar refugee camp in Beirut, Lebanon on 12 August 1976. The massacre occurred during the Lebanese Civil War, after the Tel al-Zaatar refugee camp had been under siege since January 1976 by Lebanese Christian militias of the Lebanese Front led by the Kataeb Phalangists. The attack on al-Zaatar was part of a wider campaign to expel Palestinians from Lebanon, especially those affiliated with the Palestine Liberation Organization (PLO). After the massacre, the Tel al-Zaatar refugee camp was depopulated and destroyed.

zh.t: 泰勒扎塔尔难民营大屠杀
zh.s: 泰勒扎塔尔大屠杀发生于1976年8月12日，约1500名巴勒斯坦人和黎巴嫩穆斯林在黎巴嫩贝鲁特的泰勒扎塔尔难民营遇害。此前，黎巴嫩基督教民兵组织“黎巴嫩阵线”自1976年1月起围困该难民营，其中包括由长枪党领导的武装。此次屠杀是驱逐巴勒斯坦人出黎巴嫩行动的一部分，尤其针对巴勒斯坦解放组织（PLO）成员。屠杀后，泰勒扎塔尔难民营被清空并摧毁。

en.t: 11th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party
en.s: The 11th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party was held in the Great Hall of the People, Beijing, between August 12–18, 1977, about five years before the 12th National Congress, and four years after the 10th National Congress. 1,510 delegates represented the party's estimated 35 million members. The Congress formally declared the Cultural Revolution officially over after 11 years, ending a long chapter of Chinese history.

en.t: The IBM Personal Computer is released
en.s: The IBM Personal Computer (model 5150), often referred to as the IBM PC, is the first microcomputer released in the IBM PC model line and the basis for the IBM PC compatible de facto standard. Released on August 12, 1981, it was created by a team of engineers and designers at International Business Machines (IBM), directed by William C. Lowe and Philip Don Estridge in Boca Raton, Florida.

zh.s: IBM个人电脑（型号5150，常称IBM PC）是IBM PC产品线发布的首款微型计算机，并成为IBM PC兼容机事实标准的基础。该产品于1981年8月12日发布，由国际商业机器公司（IBM）一支工程师和设计师团队开发，团队由威廉·洛和菲利普·唐·埃斯特里奇领导，地点在佛罗里达州博卡拉顿。

en.s: The 1984 Summer Olympics (officially the Games of the XXIII Olympiad and commonly known as Los Angeles 1984) were an international multi-sport event held from July 28 to August 12, 1984, in Los Angeles, California, United States. en.s: Japan Air Lines Flight 123 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Tokyo to Osaka, Japan. On the evening of Monday, August 12, 1985, the Boeing 747 flying the route suffered a severe structural failure and explosive decompression 12 minutes after takeoff. After flying under minimal control for 32 minutes, the plane crashed in the area of Mount Takamagahara, 100 kilometres (62 mi; 54 nmi) from Tokyo.

zh.s: 日本航空123号班机原定从东京飞往大阪，是一班日本国内定期客运航班。1985年8月12日星期一晚间，执飞该航线的波音747客机在起飞12分钟后发生严重结构故障并突然失压。飞机在仅能有限操控的情况下飞行32分钟后，坠毁于高天原山一带，距东京100公里（62英里；54海里）。

en.s: The North American Free Trade Agreement (Spanish: Tratado de Libre Comercio de América del Norte, TLCAN; French: Accord de libre-échange nord-américain, ALÉNA), referred to colloquially in the Anglosphere as NAFTA ( NAF-tə), was an agreement signed by Canada, Mexico, and the United States that created a trilateral trade bloc in North America. en.s: The 1994–95 Major League Baseball strike was the eighth and longest work stoppage in Major League Baseball (MLB) history, as well as the fourth in-season work stoppage in 22 years. The strike began on August 12, 1994, and resulted in the remainder of that season, including the postseason and the World Series, being canceled. en.s: The Taiwan Solidarity Party (TSP or TSU) is a political party in Taiwan which advocates Taiwan independence, and is affiliated with the Taiwanese localization movement. It was officially founded on 12 August 2001 as the Taiwan Solidarity Union (TSU) and is considered part of the Pan-Green Coalition. Unlike the Democratic Progressive Party, its larger companion party in the Pan-Green Coalition, the TSP actively campaigns for the creation of a de jure Republic of Taiwan.

en.s: Bloodymania was a professional wrestling event produced by Juggalo Championship Wrestling (JCW), which took place at midnight on August 12, 2007 at Hog Rock in Cave-In-Rock, Illinois. Professional wrestling is a type of sports entertainment in which theatrical events are combined with a competitive sport. The buildup to the matches and the scenarios that took place before, during, and after the event, were planned by JCW's script writers. The event starred wrestlers from JCW's SlamTV! internet wrestling show, as well as guest wrestlers from the independent circuit. The event was the first produced under the Bloodymania name.

en.s: The Battle of the Kodori Valley was a military operation during the Russo-Georgian War in the Upper Kodori Valley of Abkhazia, a breakaway region of Georgia. It was the only part of Abkhazia under Georgian control before this military conflict. On 9 August 2008, the Abkhaz military, with support by Russian forces, launched an operation to remove the remaining Georgian troops from the disputed gorge.

It began when U.S. and Afghan troops launched an Operation to capture the town from the Taliban, in the Helmand Province of Southern Afghanistan. en.s: The 2012 DFL-Supercup was the third DFL-Supercup, an annual football match contested by the winners of the previous season's Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal competitions. The match featured Borussia Dortmund, winners of both the 2011–12 Bundesliga and 2011–12 DFB-Pokal, and Bayern Munich, runners-up in both the Bundesliga and DFB-Pokal. en.s: The 2014 UEFA Super Cup was the 39th edition of the UEFA Super Cup, an annual football match organised by UEFA and contested by the reigning champions of the two main European club competitions, the UEFA Champions League and the UEFA Europa League. The match featured two Spanish teams Real Madrid and Sevilla, the winners of the 2013–14 UEFA Champions League and the 2013–14 UEFA Europa League respectively. It was played at the Cardiff City Stadium in Cardiff, Wales, on 12 August 2014.

The game was played between Cherno More Varna, who beat Levski Sofia to win the 2015 Bulgarian Cup Final, and Ludogorets Razgrad, champions of the 2014–15 A Group. en.s: On 12 August 2015, a series of explosions at the Port of Tianjin in Tianjin, Northern China, killed 173 people, according to official reports, and injured hundreds of others. en.s: A by-election took place on August 12, 2025, in the provincial riding of Charlottetown-Hillsborough Park to elect a member of the Legislative Assembly of Prince Edward Island. It was held on the same day as a by-election in Brackley-Hunter River. The by-election was triggered by the resignation of Natalie Jameson, who resigned on February 11, 2025, to stand as the Conservative Party of Canada candidate for Charlottetown in the 2025 Canadian federal election.
